ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, the line $l\colon y=kx-1$ ($k\neq 0$) intersects with the graph of the function $y=\frac{m}{x}$ ($x>0$) at point $A(3,2)$. What are the values of $k$ and $m$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the line $l\colon y=kx-1$ ($k\neq 0$) intersects with the graph of the function $y=\frac{m}{x}$ ($x>0$) at point $A(3,2)$,\\
we have $2=3k-1$ and $2=\frac{m}{3}$,\\
solving these equations, we find $k=\boxed{1}, m=\boxed{6}$.
